description: Main server script for a Flask-based API that handles chat completions using litellm models, with endpoints for chat and model retrieval, including environment setup and error handling.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Prints a statement if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles root URL GET request, returns a simple message.

methods.name: data_generator
methods.description: Generates streaming data chunks for responses.

methods.name: api_completion
methods.description: Handles POST requests for chat completions, processes prompt, calls litellm completion, streams response if requested.

methods.name: get_models
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve available models from litellm.
